comment: Shared wrapper-peeling vectors for the three copies of the grammar: src/hook/handler.rs (Rust unit tests), src/opencode_plugin.ts and src/pi_extension.ts (tests/plugins/peel.test.mjs). All three must agree on every case. expect=bare means the hook must leave the command running bare (Passthrough in Rust, unchanged in the plugins); expect=whole means it must be wrapped whole so its output still goes through masking.

peelable.cmd: ecotokens filter --agent claude -- bash -c 'ecotokens filter --agent opencode --cwd "/tmp/x" -- bash -c "ls -la"'

unpeelable.cmd: ecotokens filter -- echo OK # -- bash -c 'echo SHOULD_NOT_RUN'
ecotokens filter -- echo FIRST && echo SECOND -- bash -c 'echo ONLY_THIS'
ecotokens filter --agent claude -- bash -c 'ls' && cat secrets
